description: Proyecto Nacional de Fibra Óptica is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones - MinTIC, Bogotá D.C.. El Proyecto Nacional de Fibra Óptica busca promover la ampliación de la infraestructura de fibra óptica existente en el país, para así llevar Internet a un mayor número de colombianos con mejores servicios, condiciones técnicas y económicas. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones - MinTIC, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are red, fibra, óptica, nacional.. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2023-11-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
